criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: Information Seeking
categories.definition: Requests for information about COVID-19, including symptoms, transmission, and treatment.

categories.name: Safety Precautions
categories.definition: Inquiries about measures to protect oneself or others from COVID-19.

categories.name: Travel Concerns
categories.definition: Questions regarding travel safety, restrictions, and guidelines related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Myth Busting
categories.definition: Requests for clarification or debunking of myths and misinformation about COVID-19.

categories.name: Health Symptoms
categories.definition: Questions about symptoms associated with COVID-19 and related health concerns.

categories.name: Vaccination Inquiries
categories.definition: Questions regarding the availability, efficacy, and recommendations for COVID-19 vaccines.

categories.name: Community Support
categories.definition: Requests for information on how to support others or donate during the pandemic.

categories.name: Updates and Statistics
categories.definition: Requests for the latest news, statistics, and updates on COVID-19 cases and developments.

categories.name: Animal Concerns
categories.definition: Questions about the impact of COVID-19 on animals and potential transmission from animals to humans.

categories.name: Personal Experiences
categories.definition: Expressions of personal feelings or experiences related to COVID-19, including fear and anxiety.

categories.name: Treatment Options
categories.definition: Inquiries about available treatments and medical advice for COVID-19.

categories.name: Public Health Guidelines
categories.definition: Requests for official guidelines and recommendations from health authorities.

categories.name: Social Sharing
categories.definition: Requests to share information or articles related to COVID-19 with others.

categories.name: Quarantine and Isolation
categories.definition: Questions about self-isolation, quarantine measures, and their implications.

categories.name: Economic Impact
categories.definition: Inquiries about the economic effects of COVID-19 and support for affected individuals.
